fields.note:
Hi Hannah,

The draft advisory is ready for your review and sign-off. We’ve confirmed the lab results (24-1187) with Marcus, and the health effects content is finalized. The critical customers (Harvest Ridge Foods, Millbrook Regional Hospital, Westside Senior Center, and Oak Street School District) have been notified per C1, Section 5.2.

The advisory will go out via MillbrookAlert, website, social media, and media contact list within 15 minutes of approval. We’re on track to meet the 11:00 AM deadline.

Please confirm your approval and send the go-ahead to the Control Room for release.

— Jordan

original.subject: Draft Do Not Drink Advisory — Ready for Sign-Off
original.body:
Subject: Do Not Drink Advisory — Zone 1

> **DO NOT DRINK THE TAP WATER — City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer (PWS ID OH-CARVER-0418)**
> Issued October 22, 2026 at 10:58 AM.
>
> **What happened.** At 09:18 on October 22, 2026, the City identified a chemical-treatment problem in finished water serving Zone 1. The pH rose to 9.3 and caustic dose reached 38 mg/L — both exceeding safe limits. The control system is compromised and cannot be trusted.
>
> **Who is affected.** Customers in Zone 1 (Hilltop, Westside, Oak Street Corridor) bounded by Main Street, Hilltop Drive, and the Northgate Reservoir perimeter. Map: millbrook-oh.example/water-advisory
>
> **What to do.** Do not drink the tap water, cook with it, make ice, brush teeth, or give it to pets. Use bottled water. Showering and hand washing are permitted for adults, but avoid prolonged skin contact.
>
> **Health information.** Water with a very high pH can irritate the skin, eyes, mouth and throat and can cause stomach upset if swallowed. Anyone who has swallowed the water and feels unwell should call the Poison Control line or their health care provider.
>
> **Where to get water.** Bottled water distribution at Hilltop Tank (123 Oak St) from 11:00 AM. Tanker fill points at Northgate Reservoir and Orchard Standpipe.
>
> **What the City is doing.** The affected area has been isolated; the plant is being operated manually with water quality tested every two hours. We are flushing and sampling the affected area in coordination with Ohio EPA and Carver County Public Health.
>
> **Please share this notice** with everyone who uses this water.
>
> Questions: (555) 031-2222 · millbrook-oh.example/water · Next update by 11:30 AM.
>
> **Affected Area**: Zone 1 (Hilltop, Westside, Oak Street Corridor)
> **Reason**: pH 9.3, caustic 38 mg/L — exceeds safe limits
> **Public Health Effect**: Nausea, vomiting, chemical burn risk
> **Action**: Do not drink tap water; use bottled water
> **Critical Customers Notified**: Harvest Ridge Foods (confirmed), Millbrook Regional Hospital, Westside Senior Center, Oak Street School District
> **Verification**: Lab results (24-1187) confirmed by WQ
> **Next Step**: Publish via MillbrookAlert, website, social media, and media contact list
> **Request**: Sign-off from Director and WQ
> 
> — Jordan Alvarez
> Deputy PIO
> City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer
